context.transcript:
Hi, Eric.
What did you think of the leadership seminar I led yesterday?
It was nice to see the new managers from across all divisions.
Did it give you any good tips?
To be honest, I supervise a team that works with machines in manufacturing, so it didn't offer much for me.
Oh, really?
Well, I know the seminar was meant for supervisors in all divisions, but it was more appropriate for those who work in an office on computers all day.
That's good to know.
Actually, could you email me some of your comments?
That'll help me improve the seminar for the future.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，Eric。
你觉得我昨天主持的领导力研讨会怎么样？
很高兴见到来自所有部门的新经理们。
有没有给你什么好的建议？
说实话，我负责监督一个在制造业与机器一起工作的团队，所以对我来说没什么帮助。
哦，是吗？
嗯，我知道这个研讨会是为所有部门的主管准备的，但它更适合那些全天在办公室使用电脑的人。
了解了。
实际上，你能把一些你的评论通过电子邮件发给我吗？
这对我在未来改进研讨会有帮助。
